# Argent: instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the single rulebook
for every contributor and AI agent here: this repository is public, so never add
founder instructions, research, account identifiers, credentials or local paths;
every claim must match what `main` implements (agent execution is simulated);
never push to `main` directly; and verify with `npm run check`.
